subject: expression: remove `InUnion/SetInUnion` in `BuildContext` (#52706)
summary: Change removes mutable `InUnionCast` state from `expression.BuildContext` and makes the union-only CAST behavior explicit by threading an `inUnion` boolean into numeric CAST construction (`BuildCastFunctionWithCheck`), set by `BuildCastFunction4Union` and false elsewhere. Checked planner union projection call sites still use `BuildCastFunction4Union`, and CAST pushdown metadata (`tipb.InUnionMetadata`) remains correct for union vs non-union casts. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched expression/planner behavior.
